title: Prakrit Sahitya: Historical Grammar, Dialectology & Early Literary Formations
author: Dr. Satyendranarayan Goswami
description: Comprehensive philological monograph published by Publication Board Assam, analyzing the linguistic development of Middle Indo-Aryan Prakrits and Apabhramsha dialects. It examines their lexical, phonological, and substrate interactions with indigenous Tibeto-Burman and Southwestern Tai languages in Eastern India and Assam.
